Carbidopa is combined with L-Dopa in the treatment of Parkinson's disease to inhibit the peripheral conversion of L-Dopa to dopamine. Carbidopa does not cross the blood-brain barrier, ensuring its action is confined to the periphery, thereby optimizing the efficacy of L-Dopa in managing Parkinson's symptoms.
